systematic_findings.finding: Full ACL uses semantic headings such as 风险、收益、优化、判断依据. Several questions ask for the corresponding category. This can reduce lookup difficulty independently of language clarity.
systematic_findings.action: Either remove category-matching headings from Full ACL or redesign questions so that headings do not directly cue the requested answer category.
